# CARE Library Beta

CARE Library is a reading environment for following ideas through texts, arguments, and recorded connections.
CARE means Canonical Axiomatic Reduction Engine, created by William Proudler.

Discover is the public landing page. The library and its reading files require an approved beta account. Visitors can request access by providing their name and email; the team reviews each request before granting access.

- [Discover CARE](https://carelibrary.org/)
- [Log in](https://carelibrary.org/login.html)
- [Request beta access](https://carelibrary.org/request-access.html)
- [Quick start guide](https://carelibrary.org/quick-start.pdf)

Original source texts and saved AI-assisted interpretations are distinct. Recorded references describe provenance, not proof of correctness. Missing passage links must not be invented.
